lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਛੂਟੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee ko viralaa chhootai tis jan kau hau balihaaree ||3||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, a few rare ones are saved; I am a sacrifice to those humble beings. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin sisat saajee soee har jaanai taa kaa roop apaaro ||
lines.translation: The One who created the Universe, that Lord alone knows. His beauty is incomparable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aape vekh har bigasai guramukh braham beechaaro ||4||3||14||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself gazes upon it, and is pleased. The Gurmukh contemplates God. ||4||3||14||
Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਸਰਬ ਰਜਾਈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਚੈ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: keetaa karanaa sarab rajaaee kichh keechai je kar sakeeai ||
lines.translation: All that happens, and all that will happen, is by His Will. If we could do something by ourselves, we would.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੀਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaa keetaa kichhoo na hovai jiu har bhaavai tiu rakheeai ||1||
lines.translation: By ourselves, we cannot do anything at all. As it pleases the Lord, He preserves us. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere har jeeu sabh ko terai vas ||
lines.translation: O my Dear Lord, everything is in Your power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਸਾਕਹ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਬਖਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: asaa jor naahee je kichh kar ham saakah jiu bhaavai tivai bakhas ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I have no power to do anything at all. As it pleases You, You forgive us. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh jeeu pi(n)d deeaa tudh aape tudh aape kaarai laaiaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself bless us with soul, body and everything. You Yourself cause us to act.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਹੇ ਕੋ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jehaa too(n) hukam karahi tehe ko karam kamaavai jehaa tudh dhur likh paaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: As You issue Your Commands, so do we act, according to our pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀ ਕੋਈ ਛੇਵਾ ਕਰਿਉ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch tat kar tudh srisat sabh saajee koee chhevaa kariu je kichh keetaa hovai ||
lines.translation: You created the entire Universe out of the five elements; if anyone can create a sixth, let him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਬੁਝਾਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa satigur mel too(n) bujhaavahi ik manamukh karahi s rovai ||3||
lines.translation: You unite some with the True Guru, and cause them to understand, while others, the self-willed manmukhs, do their deeds and cry out in pain. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਉ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਾ ਹਉ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਨੀਚਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kee vadiaaee hau aakh na saakaa hau moorakh mugadh neechaan ||
lines.translation: I cannot describe the glorious greatness of the Lord; I am foolish, thoughtless, idiotic and lowly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪਇਆ ਅਜਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kau har bakhas lai mere suaamee saranaagat paiaa ajaan ||4||4||15||24||
lines.translation: Please, forgive servant Nanak, O my Lord and Master; I am ignorant, but I have entered Your Sanctuary. ||4||4||15||24||
Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The actor stages the play,
playing the many characters in different costumes;
but when the play ends, he takes off the costumes,
and then he is one, and only one. ||1||
How many forms and images appeared and disappeared?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਤਹਿ ਗਇਓ ਉਹੁ ਕਤ ਤੇ ਆਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: katahi gaio uhu kat te aaio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Where have they gone? Where did they come from? ||1||Pause||
Countless waves rise up from the water.
Jewels and ornaments of many different forms are fashioned from gold.
I have seen seeds of all kinds being planted
- when the fruit ripens, the seeds appear in the same form as the original. ||2||
The one sky is reflected in thousands of water jugs,
but when the jugs are broken, only the sky remains.
Doubt comes from greed, emotional attachment and the corruption of Maya.
Freed from doubt, one realizes the One Lord alone. ||3||
He is imperishable; He will never pass away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa ko aavai naa ko jaahee ||
lines.translation: He does not come, and He does not go.
The Perfect Guru has washed away the filth of ego.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak meree param gat hoee ||4||1||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I have obtained the supreme status. ||4||1||
Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
Whatever God wills, that alone happens.
Without You, there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਜ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jan seve tis pooran kaaj ||
lines.translation: The humble being serves Him, and so all his works are perfectly successful.
O Lord, please preserve the honor of Your slaves. ||1||
I seek Your Sanctuary, O Perfect, Merciful Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tujh bin kavan kare pratipaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without You, who would cherish and love me? ||1||Pause||
He is permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky.
God dwells near at hand; He is not far away.
By trying to please other people, nothing is accomplished.
When someone is attached to the True Lord, his ego is taken away. ||2||
